connector.name: Aegis by undercurrentholdings.com
connector.registryDescription: Six-gate governance for AI agents: PROCEED/PAUSE/HALT decisions with hash-chained audit trails.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.aegis.undercurrentholdings.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the Python package aegis-governance. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.undercurrentholdings, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.
